Cultures Emphasis requires 3 lower-division courses (Option 1: two survey courses from HUM 1-2 / MMW 11-12 / two LTWL 19 courses, plus one additional approved survey course; OR Option 2: a full three-course language sequence LTGK 1-2-3 or LTLA 1-2-3) plus 12 upper-division electives / 48 units from at least three different departments. buckets.label: Lower-division foundation (Option 1: surveys, or Option 2: one language sequence)
buckets.note: Three lower-division courses via ONE of two pathways. Option 1 (no language): two survey courses (HUM 1-2, or MMW 11-12, or two of LTWL 19A/B/C) plus one additional approved lower-division survey course. Option 2 (reduced language): a full three-course sequence LTGK 1-2-3 or LTLA 1-2-3.

buckets.label: Upper-division electives (from at least three departments)
buckets.note: Twelve upper-division electives (48 units) from the approved Classical Studies list, from at least three different departments.
